chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
He who obeys the sluggard loses his rights, and he who obeys the backbiter loses his friend.

key_terms.الوَاشِيَ: Backbiter, one who reports secrets or faults to cause division
key_terms.الْحُقُوقَ: Rights (duties owed to God or others)

ai.seo_question: What are the consequences of obeying the lazy and the backbiter according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies two internal vices—sluggishness (tawani) and backbiting (wash)—as the primary causes of external social decay. He distinguishes between the neglect of public duties (huquq) resulting from laziness and the erosion of private bonds (sadiq) caused by the slanderer who sows discord. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on both individual discipline and the preservation of communal harmony through vigilance against subtle character flaws.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 239. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
He who is a sluggard loses his rights and he who believes in the backbiter loses his friend.
